test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The rising rate of inflation is making life very hard for ________ poor.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**the**" is a definite article used to specify a noun that is known to the reader.
 
• In this context, "**the**" is used to specify a particular group of people, i.e., the poor.
 
• The other options: "**some**," "**all**," and "**its**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The rising rate of inflation is making life very hard for the__ poor.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Some**: means an unspecified amount or number of.
 
• **All**: means the whole quantity or extent of.
 
• **Its**: means belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.
